jump_grid_note: Zero plus seven logarithmically spaced positive values; paper does not disclose exact grid count. Fixed before performance.
controlled_selection: Mean of LR and XGB past-five-year net 0/1 Sharpes; shared JM labels, conditional means and smoothing for all models
paper_selection: XGB-only net 0/1 Sharpe; jointly choose lambda and half-life in initial validation, freeze half-life thereafter
cash_rule_note: Cash when bullish count <= 2 of 8: retains paper's <=25% threshold, rather than copying <=3 of 12 verbatim.

conventions.stock_dividends: excluded; cannot claim total-return or investable ETF replication
conventions.bond_precision: published two-decimal index levels; retain rounding, no inferred extra precision
conventions.missing_asset_level: stop; no interpolation or intersection-calendar compression
conventions.rate_information: latest observation strictly before signal date, max 10 calendar days old
conventions.currency_level: same-session published BOK reference rate, exact date required
conventions.cash_return: previous available CD(91d) annual yield / 100 / 252; modeled reserve account, not risk-free security
conventions.global_volatility: previous-date FRED VIX; proxy for global risk, not VKOSPI
conventions.market_features: 3y yield change, 10y-3y slope and slope change, log VIX change, KOSPI/GovBond 252-session correlation
conventions.execution: index signal-close to next-close convention; additional one-session delay reported separately
conventions.fees: risky legs only, reserve-account leg free; self-financing NAV equation
conventions.covariance: available-history normalized unbiased EWM, eigenvalue floor 1e-12 daily
conventions.unresolved_author_details: grid count, clipping, EWM adjust, exact timing/cash daycount/solver are implementation conventions, not author-verified
conventions.stock_bond_correlation: KOSPI / KIS aggregate BMM01, distinct from individual maturity buckets

data_design_revision.reason: Hankyung/KIS sector charts have 213 missing XKRX calendar dates including genuine trading days; no source-level interpolation accepted. Use direct KIS daily maturity indices instead. Naver stock source replaces Yahoo holiday bars and missing sessions.
data_design_revision.bond_exposure: Five maturity buckets of mixed Korean bond market; not separate government/bank/corporate credit sleeves.
